question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
-- Refined query with proper rounding
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT dm.name_id, m.id, m.date_published, m.duration
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT name_id, id, date_published, duration,
           LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as prev_date
    FROM director_movies
),
inter_movie AS (
    SELECT name_id, id,
           CASE WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL 
                THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_published - prev_date) 
                ELSE NULL 
           END as gap_days
    FROM ranked
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT name_id,
           COUNT(*) as movie_count,
           ROUND(AVG(CAST(gap_days AS INTEGER))) as avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM inter_movie
    GROUP BY name_id
),
rating_stats AS (
    SELECT dm.name_id,
           ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,
           SUM(r.total_votes) as total_votes,
           MIN(r.avg_rating) as min_rating,
           MAX(r.avg_rating) as max_rating
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
    GROUP BY dm.name_id
),
duration_stats AS (
    SELECT dm.name_id,
           SUM(m.duration) as total_movie_duration
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    GROUP BY dm.name_id
)
SELECT 
    ds.name_id,
    n.name,
    ds.movie_count,
    ds.avg_inter_movie_duration,
    rs.avg_rating,
    rs.total_votes,
    rs.min_rating,
    rs.max_rating,
    ds2.total_movie_duration
FROM director_stats ds
JOIN names n ON ds.name_id = n.id
JOIN rating_stats rs ON ds.name_id = rs.name_id
JOIN duration_stats ds2 ON ds.name_id = ds2.name_id
ORDER BY ds.movie_count DESC, ds2.total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
